comment: Dashboard: a clock (local time, plus an hour hand for a second city, orange by day and
blue at night) above weather and a stock quote. Laid out at 360 x 640 dp and scaled to
To make a new one: copy this file and edit the values under root > global > resources >
variables. Each has a 'comment' saying what it is. Strings are drawn exactly as written;
Colours are under 'colors' (#AARRGGBB): bg, face, the hands, ink/dim/faint for text,
Live updates: the variables are exported, so a host can change them while the document
Rules: set textSize before every text drawing (paint state carries over; without it all
text is the player's default size). Use glyphs the players' font (Roboto) has: ↑ ↓ ° ·
work, ▲ ▼ draw nothing. For time use timeInMin (minutes since local midnight) and
offsetToUtc (seconds). Don't use timeInSec: the screen would redraw every second.

variables.name: temp
variables.comment: Current temperature, drawn large; include the unit sign.

variables.name: location
variables.comment: Place name, under high and low.

variables.name: sunrise
variables.comment: Sunrise time, as it should read.

variables.name: sunset
variables.comment: Sunset time, as it should read.

variables.name: stock_value
variables.comment: Its value, formatted as it should read.

variables.name: stock_change
variables.comment: Change in percent, a number: >= 0 shows a green up arrow, < 0 a red down arrow.

variables.name: city2_name
variables.comment: Name under the clock centre for the extra hour hand.

variables.name: city2_utc_offset
variables.comment: That city's offset from UTC, in hours (8 = Beijing).

variables.name: city2_min
variables.comment: Derived from the time; don't edit.

variables.name: city2_hour
variables.comment: Derived from the time; don't edit.

variables.name: city2_is_day
variables.comment: Derived from the time; don't edit.
